title: 30-Day Infrastructure Starter™
intro: Pick one gap. Build one system for it. Resist adding a second.

upsell.name: The Leadership Infrastructure Build Plan™
upsell.copy: turns this starter into a full 30-day build plan.

nodes.label: Week One — Name The Gap
nodes.prompt: Identify the single infrastructure gap costing you the most right now.

nodes.label: Week Two — Design The Minimum
nodes.prompt: Sketch the smallest version of a system that would close it.

nodes.label: Week Three — Test It
nodes.prompt: Run it for a week. Note where it holds and where it breaks.

nodes.label: Week Four — Decide What Stays
nodes.prompt: Keep what worked. Cut what didn't. Write down the final version.

closing.prompt: The system I'm committing to build this month is:
